The two‑dimensional (2D) array RiverStats[] stores the daily measurement of biological
oxygen demand (BOD) for each river.
The two‑dimensional (2D) array DaysCount[] stores the number of days each river is classed
as moderately polluted and the number of days each river is classed as highly polluted.
The position of the data for any river is the same in all three arrays. For example, the data in
index 2 of RiverStats[] belongs to the river in index 2 of RiverNames[]

• Input and store the names of the rivers in the array RiverNames[]
• For each river, input and store in the array RiverStats[], the daily BOD in milligrams per
litre (mg / L) on each of the 30 days.
• Once all the inputs for the 30 days have been completed, the following statistics are
calculated, and when appropriate, stored:

for each river.
• Output for each river, the average daily BOD readings, the number of days with moderate
pollution and the number of days with high pollution.
